tools.name: get_contact_info
tools.description: Returns contact information for Symbols of Wealth Studio — email, website, location, and how to engage. Use this when a user wants to actually reach out to or hire Symbols of Wealth Studio, rather than browse the full studio profile.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_contact_info · Private data: get_contact_info · Public sink: get_contact_info.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_contact_info · Private data: get_contact_info · Public sink: get_contact_info

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_studio_info" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
